name: LunarCrush
description: Access comprehensive social analytics and market intelligence for companies, brands, stocks, and cryptocurrencies through LunarCrush's AI-data platform. Stream real-time social metrics, sentiment analysis, trending topics, and market data directly into your AI workflows.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LunarCrush to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LunarCrush to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://lunarcrush.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LunarCrush MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LunarCrush provides these MCP tools: List, Cryptocurrencies, Stocks, Topic, Creator, Post, Topic_Time_Series, Topic_Posts, Search, Fetch, and Authentication.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LunarCrush?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LunarCrush in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
LunarCrush requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LunarCrush is developed by LunarCrush. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
